_comment: Definitions only, never values (AL-0, docs/research/ADAPTIVE_LEARNING_2026-09-26.md section 19.3). Owner: src/model_registry/feature_dictionary.py. A changed definition is a NEW version: add an entry with version+1 and keep the old one; editing an entry in place breaks its definitionHash and fails validation, and recomputing that hash still disagrees with the append-only feature_dictionary.lock.json, where a new version appends a new row.

features.name: source_board_native_value
features.unit: vendor native value on the vendor's own published scale (players only; pick rows dropped)
features.knownAtRule: the board's bytes at the training run's inputs commit, which is at or before trainingCutoff; dataset-state data clocks after the cutoff are refused (training_run._dataset_state_pin)
features.missingSemantics: an absent board is pinned sha256 'missing' with rowsRead/playerRows None, and an absent column is pinned missingColumn; neither is 0 and neither trains
features.lineage: B10 provider family of the source key (data_contract.correlation_group_for); one trainer per family per scope
features.description: The native value column a Hill training or holdout board publishes, as loaded by the training manifest.

features.name: canonical_training_percentile
features.unit: percentile in (0, 1] against the fixed PERCENTILE_REFERENCE_N combined-pool reference, tail-clamped
features.knownAtRule: a deterministic function of a row's rank within its board; known whenever the board is known
features.missingSemantics: rows past FIT_TOP_N are not fitted; they have no training percentile rather than a percentile of 0
features.description: The canonical percentile coordinate each trainer row is fitted at.

features.name: source_universe_log_rank
features.unit: -log(rank) of a row within its universe (OFFENSE / IDP / PICK) on one published source version, ties averaged
features.knownAtRule: a version is selectable at t only when its git committer time known_at <= t (ObservationPanel.truncated removes later versions)
features.missingSemantics: a row a source did not publish is an absent cell (NaN), never rank 0 or value 0; ambiguous or unclassified identities are withheld and counted
features.lineage: the publishing source's B10 provider family
features.description: The point-in-time scale-free evidence a source version contributes to the source-quality panel.

features.name: family_evidence_age_days
features.unit: days since the family's freshest member version, at each panel date
features.knownAtRule: computed from version known_at stamps at or before the panel date only
features.missingSemantics: a family with no version yet is NaN (unknown age), never age 0
features.description: How old a family's newest evidence was on each date; separates staleness from base quality.

features.name: provider_family
features.knownAtRule: read from the source registry at the producer's code revision; never re-labelled after the fact
features.missingSemantics: an unregistered source has no family and cannot be evaluated or trained; it is never assigned to a default family
features.description: Which correlation family a source belongs to; the unit of independence for holdouts and caps.

features.name: single_family_observation
features.unit: board-scale 0-9999 value of the one provider family that priced a single-family row (the observation the estimator keeps as central evidence)
features.knownAtRule: computed by the build of the board being recorded; a shadow record builds from the payload and this box's live source CSVs / dataset state, all read before the record's recordedAt (the receipt cutoff)
features.missingSemantics: a row no family priced is not scoped (evidenceState no_usable_evidence: unpriced, never 0); the observation is never multiplied by a constant or replaced by 0
features.lineage: the observing source's B10 provider family (one family by construction)
features.description: The single family's observation that candidate C keeps instead of the 0.30 single-source haircut.

features.name: censored_family_bound
features.unit: board-scale 0-9999 cutoff U: an upper bound on a row's value under a healthy family that covers the position and did not list the player
features.knownAtRule: computed by the build of the board being recorded; a shadow record builds from the payload and this box's live source CSVs / dataset state, all read before the record's recordedAt (the receipt cutoff)
features.missingSemantics: no bound exists unless every source_status / family_bounds condition holds; unknown coverage, a failed or stale fetch, an inapplicable source, an unranked position or doubtful identity is a counted refusal, never a bound of 0
features.lineage: per ABSENT B10 provider family; a family bound is its loosest member bound
features.description: What a family that omitted the player can still say: the player sits beyond its published depth.

features.name: sparse_evidence_state
features.unit: categorical evidenceState: why a row rests on one family and how much its absences can say
features.knownAtRule: computed by the build of the board being recorded; a shadow record builds from the payload and this box's live source CSVs / dataset state, all read before the record's recordedAt (the receipt cutoff)
features.missingSemantics: no_usable_evidence is its own state (unpriced); there is no default category
features.lineage: derived from per-family presence and refusal; families are counted, never sources
features.description: The certainty half of the sparse-evidence answer; it never moves the central value.

features.name: source_board_scale_vote
features.unit: board-scale 0-9999 vote of one source on one row: the stamped pre-filter valueContribution
features.knownAtRule: stamped by the build of the board being recorded, BEFORE either outlier filter runs (so identical in both builds); a live shadow record reads the payload and the live tree before its recordedAt (the receipt cutoff)
features.missingSemantics: an observation with an excludedReason (zero freshness / health weight) or a non-positive contribution is not a vote: absent, never 0
features.lineage: the voting source's B10 provider family
features.description: The observations both outlier filters judge, persisted per board as the write-once observation panel.

features.name: precap_evidence_weight
features.unit: effective weight (base x freshness x health x coverage) of one observation before the family cap, >= 0
features.knownAtRule: stamped by the build of the board being recorded (sourceRankMeta preFamilyWeight / appliedWeight); read before the record's recordedAt
features.missingSemantics: preFamilyWeight when stamped, else appliedWeight, else the registry base 1.0; an unparseable stamp is weight 0.0 in the producer, which means the observation carries no evidence weight, not that it was observed at 0
features.lineage: per voting source; capped per B10 family by data_contract.cap_family_weights
features.description: The evidence weight the challenger filter sees before the family cap.

features.name: provider_family
features.knownAtRule: read from the source registry at the producer's code revision; never re-labelled after the fact
features.missingSemantics: an unregistered source has no family and cannot be evaluated or trained; it is never assigned to a default family
features.description: Which correlation family a source belongs to: v1's definition, extended to the AL-1a shadow families as consumers (allowedConsumers is part of a definition, so this is a new version).

features.name: trade_observation_lane
features.unit: categorical acquisition lane of one observation: ktc_trade_database | sleeper_sharp_discovery | own_league_sleeper (spec section 19.7 provenance KTC_MARKET / SHARP_DISCOVERY / OWN_LEAGUE)
features.knownAtRule: fixed when the observation is normalized from its lane's store; a fold may use an observation only if it was collected at or before the fold cutoff (collectedAt <= T, design section 5)
features.missingSemantics: an observation without a lane is refused, never defaulted to a Sleeper lane; a deduplicated trade seen through several lanes carries every lane and contributes ONE event, and Sleeper-observed versus KTC-database evidence is never merged into one undifferentiated count
features.lineage: market-trade ledger observation (src/trade/market_trade_normalize.py); KTC-database observations share population lineage with the KTC Trades family and are never independent evidence for it
features.description: Which acquisition lane observed a completed trade, so Sleeper-observed and KTC-database evidence stay separately counted and their overlap can be measured.

features.name: trade_dedupe_state
features.unit: categorical section 19 dedupe state of the underlying trade: CONFIRMED_UNIQUE | CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE | PROBABLE_DUPLICATE | POSSIBLE_OVERLAP | UNRESOLVED
features.knownAtRule: recomputed per fold from observations collected at or before the fold cutoff; a group formed with a later observation is never used for an earlier fold
features.missingSemantics: UNRESOLVED is its own state, never read as CONFIRMED_UNIQUE; volume-sensitive use excludes POSSIBLE_OVERLAP and UNRESOLVED (market_trade_eval.fit_suitability) rather than counting one event twice
features.lineage: market-trade ledger groups over all lanes
features.description: Whether an observed trade is a proven-unique underlying event, so one trade seen on Sleeper and KTC is counted once.

features.name: trade_format_disposition
features.unit: categorical target-pricing disposition: NATIVE_COMPARABLE | VALIDATED_TRANSFORMABLE | BROAD_CONTEXT | TARGET_UNSUPPORTED, with every axis attached
features.knownAtRule: from the format capture in force at the trade (formatEvidence, timing-capped by format_timing_cap) and only captures collected at or before the fold cutoff
features.missingSemantics: an unknown axis is UNKNOWN and caps the disposition at BROAD_CONTEXT format_unknown; it never becomes MATCH, and an unverified dynasty state is a hard exclusion
features.lineage: format fingerprint tmf1 from Sleeper league captures or KTC vendor settings
features.description: How comparable the trade's league format is to the declared reference or target format; unknown format stays unknown.

features.name: trade_topology
features.unit: categorical package topology (1-for-1, two-team multi-asset, one-sided, multi-team, empty) plus flags (unresolved, faab, startup pick, pick beyond round 6)
features.knownAtRule: a function of the trade's own normalized sides, fixed at normalization
features.missingSemantics: an unresolved asset is flagged includes_unresolved, never dropped from its side; a dropped asset would turn an n-for-1 into a false 1-for-1
features.description: The shape of the package, so consolidation effects are modelled rather than read as equal raw sums.

features.name: trade_fit_suitability
features.unit: categorical clean_1_for_1 | package_va_required | unsuitable, with exclusion reasons
features.knownAtRule: a function of topology, dedupe state and format at the fold cutoff
features.missingSemantics: unsuitable carries every reason (three_or_more_teams, includes_unresolved, includes_faab, dedupe_state, dynasty_state_unverified, qb_format_unknown); an exclusion is reported and counted per reason, never silent
features.lineage: derived from trade_topology, trade_dedupe_state and the market format
features.description: Whether a trade can enter the latent-price fit and, if not, why; package trades require a package model, never an equality of sums.
